title: Nature Conservation Area Visit

words.clue: The red animal has a white-tipped bushy tail: a ___.
words.reason: The red fox is the only red, bushy-tailed animal in this bank.
words.pictureSubject: One adult red fox with a clearly white-tipped bushy tail, standing calmly on a small forest-floor patch, no cub or other animal.

words.clue: The fallen tree trunk is a ___.
words.reason: A fallen trunk rather than a thin twig or animal home.
words.pictureSubject: One large fallen tree log with bark and a visible circular cut end, lying on a small woodland-floor patch, no animals or loose branches.

words.clue: A tiny six-legged insect is a ___.
words.reason: The small insect, not a web or a larger animal.
words.pictureSubject: One friendly red ladybird insect with six clear small legs and two antennae, large enough to see its shape, on a plain leaf without other insects.

words.clue: A spider spins silk into a ___.
words.reason: The silk structure made by a spider identifies web.
words.pictureSubject: One delicate circular spider web stretched between two short forest twigs, tiny spider at the edge, the web is dominant and clearly outlined.

words.clue: The fox's underground home is a ___.
words.reason: The animal home is the den, not the fallen log.
words.pictureSubject: One empty fox den entrance under tree roots in a small woodland bank, dark rounded opening and earthy tunnel edge, no fox or cub.

words.clue: The wet dirt beside the trail is ___.
words.reason: The wet soil substance is mud.
words.pictureSubject: One shallow brown muddy puddle beside a woodland trail, glossy wet dirt with no footprints or animals, a tiny fern at the edge.

words.clue: The bright round star lights the day: the ___.
words.reason: The daytime star is distinct from every terrestrial object.
words.pictureSubject: One bright golden sun with rounded clear rays above a small silhouette of woodland trees, no text or face.

words.clue: The pond tool has a hoop and woven mesh: a ___.
words.reason: The mesh pond-study tool identifies net.
words.pictureSubject: One empty pond-study dip net with a circular hoop, fine mesh and wooden handle, resting at a ranger observation station, no captured wildlife.

words.clue: Litter goes in the park's rubbish ___.
words.reason: The only rigid rubbish container in this bank.
words.pictureSubject: One sturdy green lidded conservation-area rubbish bin, clear lid and opening, small recycle symbol allowed, forest path edge and no writing.

words.clue: The paper drawing shows the reserve's paths: a ___.
words.reason: A paper path drawing is a map.
words.pictureSubject: One unfolded paper nature-reserve trail map with winding paths, a pond shape and tree symbols, no words, letters or numbers.

words.clue: A baby fox is a ___.
words.reason: The age-specific animal name identifies cub; adult fox is in the other bank.
words.pictureSubject: One very young red fox cub with a small fluffy body, large gentle eyes and tiny paws, sitting on a woodland patch, no adult fox.

words.clue: A beaver blocks a stream with a ___.
words.reason: The stream barrier made by a beaver identifies dam.
words.pictureSubject: One clear beaver dam made from interwoven sticks across a small stream, held-back water on one side and a gentle trickle below, no people or animals.

words.clue: The furry mammal with wings is a ___.
words.reason: A winged mammal distinguishes bat from the other animals and plant parts.
words.pictureSubject: One small friendly brown flying mammal bat with two clearly spread leathery wings, hanging from a short tree branch, never a sports bat.

words.clue: A flower that has not opened is a ___.
words.reason: The unopened flower identifies bud rather than seed pod.
words.pictureSubject: Close view of one tightly closed green-and-pink flower bud on a short stem, no open flowers and no seed pods.

words.clue: The sticky liquid from a tree is ___.
words.reason: The tree liquid is sap, distinct from a solid seed or plant part.
words.pictureSubject: Close view of amber tree sap forming a shiny thick drop on tree bark, a small bark patch only, no collecting container or people.

words.clue: A fish steers with a flat body part called a ___.
words.reason: The named fish appendage is a fin.
words.pictureSubject: Close view of one small freshwater fish with its side fin clearly extended and gently highlighted by a simple shape, no text or labels.

words.clue: The hard acorn is a ___.
words.reason: Acorn identifies nut, distinct from a seed pod or bud.
words.pictureSubject: One large brown acorn nut with its textured cap, isolated on a small oak-leaf patch, no other seeds or nuts.

words.clue: A plant's seed case is a ___.
words.reason: A botanical seed case identifies pod, not a cloth bag.
words.pictureSubject: One dry split seed pod with several seeds visible inside, attached to a short dried stalk, no bag, flowers or other plant parts.

words.clue: The reusable litter sack is a ___.
words.reason: A flexible reusable sack distinguishes bag from the small string label.
words.pictureSubject: One open green reusable cleanup bag with soft flexible sides and two handles, empty and isolated on a tiny visitor-trail patch, no tools or rubbish inside.

words.clue: A small label tied on a string is a ___.
words.reason: The tied label identifies tag rather than the flexible bag.
words.pictureSubject: One plain cream tree-study label tag on a short loop of string tied around a narrow twig, entirely blank with no writing.

blendPictures.frog: One green pond frog with broad back legs and clear webbed feet sitting on a small damp stone, no other animals.
blendPictures.slug: One smooth brown garden slug with two visible feelers, no shell and no legs, on a small moist forest-floor patch.
blendPictures.twig: One short thin forked woody twig isolated on a small woodland-floor patch, no leaves hiding its outline.
blendPictures.stem: Close view of one green plant stalk between soil and two leaves, the upright stem clearly highlighted by a simple curved shape, not a whole potted plant.
blendPictures.grass: One compact tufted carpet patch of many upright green grass blades, no flowers or separate potted plant.
blendPictures.plant: One complete young broad-leaf seedling with roots visible in a small soil cross-section and several leaves above, clearly a whole plant.
blendPictures.grub: One curled cream C-shaped beetle grub with a brown head and six tiny front legs, isolated on dark soil, clearly different from a legless slug.
blendPictures.clip: One small silver metal pinch clip holding the top of a reusable field bag, clear clamp shape, no words or extra equipment.
blendPictures.drip: Close view of a leaf tip with three clear water drops falling separately below it into a tiny puddle, no people.
blendPictures.spot: Close view of one green leaf with a single bold round brown spot, the round mark is dominant, no extra spots or labels.
blendPictures.track: A line of several small animal pawprints continuing along a woodland mud patch, clear direction of travel, no animal or craft paper.
blendPictures.print: One clear green leaf-stamp print on a small sheet of white craft paper, original leaf beside its impression at the visitor-centre craft table, no letters or pawprints.
blendPictures.sniff: One friendly dog on a clearly visible lead lowering its nose to sniff grass beside a designated reserve path, no loose dog or wildlife interaction.
blendPictures.brim: Close view of a khaki sun hat with its projecting front brim clearly highlighted by a simple curved shape, woodland visitor-centre setting, no writing.
blendPictures.drop: One empty snack wrapper falling from an open hand into a reusable cleanup bag, simple downward motion arrow, no litter left on the ground.
blendPictures.step: One broad wooden stair step at a visitor-centre doorway, strong single raised level and woodland edge, no writing.
blendPictures.clap: Close view of a child visitor bringing palms together in applause after a ranger talk inside the visitor centre, friendly adult ranger in soft background, no wildlife beside them.
blendPictures.skip: One cheerful child taking a light step-and-hop skip on a wide designated open-meadow path, adult guide in the distance, no fragile habitat or boardwalk edge.
blendPictures.flat: One broad smooth flat-topped grey stone beside a reserve pond, low side view clearly shows its level top, no people or writing.
blendPictures.swim: One duck actively swimming across a small patch of pond water with a clear wake behind it, no other animals or people.

scenes.title: Visitor trail
scenes.sceneSubject: A welcoming conservation-area visitor trail through mixed woodland, an adult ranger with three diverse child visitors staying on the designated path, a simple map stand, rubbish bin and fallen log beside the path, open sunny sky, no wildlife feeding or written labels.

scenes.title: Pond
scenes.sceneSubject: A peaceful conservation pond beside a wooden observation boardwalk, an adult ranger and diverse children observing from the boardwalk, reeds, a small beaver dam, empty pond-study nets at a station and a duck on the water, no captured animals or text.

scenes.title: Woodland
scenes.sceneSubject: A rich woodland conservation habitat with oak trees, a den bank, wildflower buds, seed pods and a fallen branch, a fox family and small bat visible at a respectful distance, diverse child visitors and adult ranger remain on the designated path, no handling or feeding wildlife, no words.

coverSubject: A cheerful diverse group of three child visitors with an adult ranger explores a nature conservation area from a wide wooden pond boardwalk; woodland trees, reeds and a duck on the pond surround them, a red fox is visible at a respectful distance on the far bank, binoculars and a field bag, no feeding or handling wildlife and no written labels.
rainSubject: The conservation-area visitor trail during a gentle rainy day, an adult ranger and diverse children in waterproof jackets and boots stay on the designated path, clear rain drops, green leaves, puddles and a visitor-centre porch, wildlife left undisturbed, no words.
